verdict_honest_reading.s83_stub_winner_did_NOT_transfer: The §83 stub winner R3 (cell4, motivation+critical) measured dec_var 0.250 / maj_frac 0.50 on the hand-coded LCG surrogate psi-state; at trained-saturated scale it COLLAPSED to dec_var 0.0 / maj_frac 1.0. verdict_honest_reading.only_escapee_is_a_window_artifact: cell5 (R4 slow_dwell) is the ONLY cell that escaped near-collapse (dec_var 0.09, maj_frac 0.9). It escapes ONLY because its 5-step dwell-window needs >=3 samples before it can fire — giving 2 startup REMAIN_SILENT steps before the constant-psi forces it into constant EMIT (stream_head shows REMAIN_SILENT,REMAIN_SILENT,EMIT,EMIT,... then all-EMIT to step 20). This is a window-warmup artifact, NOT genuine physics-rule discrimination.
verdict_honest_reading.verdict_bucket_is_a_threshold_technicali: The runner verdict bucket PHYSICS-RULES-SURVIVE-AT-TRAINED-SCALE fired because the pre-registered threshold logic (alpha: any rule dec_var>0.05 AND maj_frac<0.95, AND any rule beats cell0 on both) is technically satisfied by cell5 alone (dec_var 0.09>0.05, maj 0.9<0.95, vs cell0 dec_var 0.0/maj 1.0). But the honest reading is the OPPOSITE of the bucket name: this is a near-total collapse, NOT survival. 1 of 5 R-rules shows any variation, and that 1 is a startup-window artifact.
verdict_honest_reading.honest_verdict: NEAR-COLLAPSE-AT-TRAINED-SCALE — the §49/§62 majority-collapse pattern REPRODUCES for closed-form physics-only rules at trained-saturated scale. Physics-only metacognition (decision = pure closed-form function of Law-71 psi-state) does NOT escape the collapse: when the trained-saturated forward produces a near-constant psi-state, every pure-threshold rule degenerates to a constant decision. The §49 distillation null-control (cell0) ALSO collapsed (maj_frac 1.0) — so closed-form rules did NOT structurally outperform the distilled head; both collapsed together.
